text:
marco: Weird one — on the latency dashboard p99 for /v1/chat is showing ~150ms while p50 is ~220ms after we enabled route-affinity optimization at 08:03 UTC. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/route-affinity.png :confused:
tess: That smells like sketch merge/order + tiny-slice contamination. Can you share the panel aggregation?
marco: Using the stacked percentile widget that reads per-shard t-digests and merges for the 1h rollup. Time window 08:00-09:00. Query is the default.
devon: Quick check: run `SELECT approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.5), approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99), count(*) FROM latency_events WHERE route='/v1/chat' AND time >= now()-interval '1 hour' GROUP BY shard_id;` If one shard has very small N with lots of 20ms cache hits, the merged tdigest centroids can pull p99 down.
marco: Ran that — shard-7 N=31 (median 18ms), shard-2 N=980 (median 230ms). Merged result was non-monotonic.
tess: Short-term UX fix: surface per-slice sample_count (and a tiny "low confidence" tag) on percentile lines; hide p99 if sample_count < 100 and show a tooltip that quantiles are approximated from sketches.
devon: Backend quick fix: when slice_count < threshold, compute exact percentiles from raw events rather than relying on merges. Medium-term: keep both sketches+compact raw-summary per interval so UI can choose deterministic exacts for small N.
metricsbot: note-bot: incident-note created (INC-2025-042) for route-affinity percentile inversion.
marco: I'll add an annotation on the dashboard at 08:03 for the route-affinity rollout. Also tagging customers on that route to watch for user-visible regressions.
tess: I'll file a small console PR to add the sample_count and confidence badge. Devon, can you sketch the fallback PR?
devon: Yep, will open PR with simple fallback and tests. :white_check_mark:
